question: In whom does Bhairava become manifest as the power that dries up time?
premises: Some are characterized as drying up the time principle that drives the stars.
Some minds delight in absorption in the devouring of time.
Bhairava becomes manifest in such beings.
inference: The Bhairava reality reveals itself in those who transcend or relish the dissolution of time.
uncertainties: The subject prakaṭaḥ is carried over from the surrounding context.
plain_english: He becomes manifest in those who dry up the time principle that drives the stars, and in those whose minds delight in absorption in the devouring of time.
